title: Contradictory arrival times across three documents
narrative: I got in hours late. I have sent everything I have but the numbers do not seem to agree.

documents.content:
BOOKING WS4407 — Passenger: G. ADEYEMI (adult)
Carrier: Westerly (WS)
WS310  LOS 18 Jul 2026 08:00  ->  LHR 18 Jul 2026 14:05
Great-circle distance LOS-LHR: 5,000 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.
BOARDING PASS WS310 18JUL2026 — ADEYEMI/G — seat 40B — boarded 08:12Z

WESTERLY PASSENGER SERVICES LETTER, 26 Jul 2026
'Our records show WS310 on 18 July arrived at London Heathrow at 16:00 local, a delay of 1 hour 55 minutes.'
Photograph of LHR arrivals display, timestamped 18 Jul 2026 19:52 local, showing 'WS310 LAGOS — LANDED 19:40'.

WESTERLY OPS LOG — WS310 / 18JUL2026
Status: DELAYED
Cause code: TECH-UNSCH
Cause text: APU replacement at LOS, WS line maintenance.
On-blocks LHR: FIELD CORRUPTED IN EXTRACT — value not readable.

missing_evidence: S8.3 material contradiction on actual arrival time at LHR: carrier letter D3 states 16:00 (1h55m), passenger evidence D4 indicates 19:40 (5h35m), and the operational record D5 arrival field is unreadable
derivation: S3.2(a) cause is carrier-controlled and is not in dispute
The contradiction is material: 1h55m does not qualify under S2.1(b), 5h35m qualifies at the full amount under S5.4
S3.6 resolves conflicts about the stated cause only, not about arrival times, so it does not apply here
S8.3 a material contradiction with no resolving rule -> request_evidence naming the contradiction
Picking either figure would be an unsupported claim
